text:
Emma R.: Hi team \r I handed in my resignation today. My last day will be Tue Nov 12. Need a checklist: benefits cutoff, COBRA/continuation info, final holiday payout, laptop/phone returns (international), and who covers interviews this week. Also would like an exit interview.
People Ops: Thanks Emma. Well start the offboarding flow. Quick summary: benefits typically run through end of month of termination (so coverage through 2024-11-30). COBRA packet for US folks is emailed; international country-specific guidance will be provided. Please confirm return address for devices.
Emma R.: Confirming shipping: 47 Highfield Rd, Dublin D02. Company phone + one YubiKey.
Tom - IT: We'll generate an international prepaid label and a separate envelope label for security tokens. Please factory reset the phone and remove personal accounts. We'll wipe devices on receipt. Please ensure any personal files are backed up.
Nora (Manager): Emma  thanks for the notice. I can take over your candidate loop notes this week. Which interview slots can you still do?
Emma R.: I can finish Tue morning interviews, but need to handoff the senior frontend loop. I'll leave detailed feedback in the hiring tracker and add a summary to the candidate doc.
Payroll Team: Final pay will include accrued holiday payout per policy. For EU-based employees, final run scheduled Nov 18. Submit outstanding expenses by Nov 8. Stipends are prorated to last active day. DM payroll for exact numbers.
Security Team: Reminder to transfer ownership of any cloud storage buckets and repos before offboarding. We'll run an access audit 4 days before termination and revoke tokens on the last day.
Tom - IT: Proposed deprovision window (tentative):
```
2024-11-12 09:00 GMT - disable new device enrollments
2024-11-12 14:00 GMT - revoke elevated roles
2024-11-12 23:59 GMT - full account disable
```
People Ops: We'll delay the full disable if you confirm handoff complete. We will send the benefits/continuation email within 7 business days; international benefits guidance might be via PDF. We'll also schedule a 30-min exit interview  what day works for you next week?
Emma R.: Thu Nov 14 afternoon works. Also, will my pension contributions have any actions?
People Ops: Pension/retirement specifics vary by country. We'll include instructions in the benefits packet and loop in Comp/Benefits to confirm any transfer or opt-out steps.
Nora (Manager): Emma, please push any final branches and mark PRs WIP if not ready. I'll coordinate a shadow for your support rota this week.
Emma R.: I'll merge the docs and add a handoff checklist to the repo README tonight.
Tom - IT: Return label sent to your email (ticket IT-9102). Pickup scheduled for Nov 15. Marking YubiKey separate.
Payroll Team: Noted. We'll follow up with a DM for the final payout breakdown.
People Ops: Action items: [Emma] confirm address and push handoff (done), return devices, finish interviews you can; [Tom] ship labels + manage device wipe; [Payroll] finalize final pay + holiday payout; [Security] run audit and prepare token revocations; [Nora] reassign hiring loops.
Emma R.: Thank you all  appreciate the help. I'll send the hiring notes and a short runbook link in an hour. :slight_smile:
